entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a technical fault. The pulse reader is complete garbage. The numbers are all over the place.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with the pulse accuracy. I know how important that data is. Sometimes a quick software update or a sensor reset can resolve that. Would you be willing to try a few troubleshooting steps with me?
No. I don't have time for all that. I just want money back. I want a refund.
Okay, I understand you'd prefer not to troubleshoot. Let me just pull up your order details and check the return eligibility for you. One moment, please.
Alright, thank you for your patience. I see the order here, and it looks like the VeloBand was delivered about 30 days ago. Is that correct?
Okay. Well, I've checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process that return and get a shipping label emailed over to you right away.
Fine. So I get the full refund?

That's correct. A full refund will be issued to your original payment method as soon as we receive the device back at our warehouse. Also, I see you're a VIP member with us. For the inconvenience this has caused, I'd like to add a $25 credit to your VeloFit account. You can use that on any future purchase.
Great. The credit has been applied, and the email with your return label is on its way. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you again for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
